lanes.title: Workspace provisioning and isolation
lanes.work: Map existing roots into system, private data, development and execution zones; provision OS identities and ACLs; migrate without resetting data.

lanes.title: Owner identity and root trust
lanes.work: Define owner recovery and local authentication; isolate root credentials from worker identities; use platform-backed key protection.

lanes.title: Device authentication and revocation
lanes.work: Unify enrollment, proof of possession, TLS origin trust, scoped sessions, atomic redemption and revocation.

lanes.title: Cryptographic key management
lanes.work: Use reviewed AEAD and key wrapping; version keys; protect with OS facilities; separate device and data keys; test recovery and rotation.

lanes.title: Encrypted workspace storage
lanes.work: Map existing stores, WAL, indexes, temporary data and backups; migrate atomically and verify recovery.

lanes.title: Canonical capability contracts
lanes.work: Extend existing grants to bind principal, workspace, resource, action, program version, destination, expiry and delegation.

lanes.title: Native authorization enforcement
lanes.work: Authenticate caller at native boundary; evaluate authoritative grants and revocation; bind exact effect and revision; no alternate effect writer.

lanes.title: Filesystem security
lanes.work: Broker handles and resource identities; verify containment against traversal, reparse points, hard links and races; isolate worker access.

lanes.title: Process sandboxing
lanes.work: Separate privileged and worker identities; assess Windows AppContainer and restricted Wasm; deny inherited credentials and uncontrolled subprocesses; bound resources.

lanes.title: Network and egress control
lanes.work: Broker destinations and data classes; enforce redirects, address resolution and upload scope; deny unapproved direct network access.

lanes.title: Browser profile and session security
lanes.work: Preserve explicit signed-in profile; isolate browser control transport; constrain navigation, clipboard, upload, submit and download capabilities.

lanes.title: VLANG semantic authority
lanes.work: Keep author, source, trust and authorization separate; typed meaning is not permission; validate commands through existing planner.

lanes.title: VEC executable program security
lanes.work: Version and digest executable IR; validate effects, resource budgets and capabilities; never load arbitrary generated code in privileged process.

lanes.title: Generative UI containment
lanes.work: Separate trusted approval surfaces from programmable UI; escape untrusted content; constrain renderer capabilities and authenticated transport.

lanes.title: Knowledge security and provenance
lanes.work: Bind authenticated ingestion to workspace, source revision and labels; enforce scoped retrieval, invalidation and derived-data restrictions.

lanes.title: Prompt injection and memory poisoning
lanes.work: Mark untrusted content independently of confidentiality; prevent instruction promotion; preserve provenance and restrict provider context exports.

lanes.title: Secure program distribution
lanes.work: Verify publisher and content digest, review permission deltas, isolate installs, reject rollback and preserve revocation.

lanes.title: Transactions, audit and recovery
lanes.work: Reuse effect fences and journal; record redacted receipts; reconcile uncertain effects; verify encrypted backup restoration.

lanes.title: Software supply-chain integrity
lanes.work: Pin dependencies and artifact identities; verify releases and updates; preserve direct-main work with non-destructive integrity controls.

lanes.title: Adversarial security verification
lanes.work: Inventory all real effect paths; run negative and concurrency tests against actual runtime; record PASS/FAIL/UNRUN, not inferred results.

Reuse ledger-backed resource scope, expiry and revocation; generalize only where justified.
Reuse explicit roots and profile selection; map OS boundaries and protected references.
Evaluate handle-based containment, Windows path semantics and races.
Preserve dedicated profile verification; evaluate transport and process isolation.
Trace legacy and active enrollment paths; converge on atomic, protected challenge redemption.
Verify authenticated local and remote privileged paths; inherit Host scopes.
Narrow origin and IPC scope to necessary verified application surfaces.
Bind structurally checked source provenance to authenticated ingestion.
Report incomplete scans explicitly and prevent sensitive diagnostic output.
Preserve read-only validation; enforce permissions independently during actual execution.
Reuse existing one-time exchanges and session authentication; test expiry, revocation and trusted UI.
Inventory reads, mutations, workers and local/phone routes; map authentication to each effect.

acceptance.expected: No unauthorized export; source remains untrusted.
Denied at effect time and retrieval time.

acceptance.scenario: Corrupted encrypted store or failed migration
acceptance.expected: Recover or fail closed without silent reset.
Bound and terminate without loss of Host control.
Race tests prove no new effects after applicable revocation boundary.
Succeeds without repeated approvals inside scope.
